run_catch_exceptions_test: run the googletest catch exceptions test suite to verify C++ and SEH exception handling
test_catch_cxx_exceptions_in_fixture_con: test that C++ exceptions thrown in a test fixture constructor are caught and logged
test_catch_cxx_exceptions_in_set_up_test: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUpTestSuite are caught and remaining teardown runs as expected
test_catch_cxx_exceptions_in_test_body: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test body are caught and TearDown still executes
test_unhandled_cxx_exceptions_abort_prog: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
